listing.name: Phillip Andrada Gas Station Manager
listing.summary: A mod which sees Supreme Executor Phillip Andrada embrace his true dream: Becoming the best damn gas station manager in the Persean Sector.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a full faction with unique ships, weapons, officers, and fleet mechanics, including a new main menu mission and custom market music.

description:
Quote

"My loyal customers, my hardworking employees, my friends! These past twenty-five cycles have been a tumultuous time for us all. Yet despite this, we continue to move forward! Though there are those who continue to doubt us, the Sindrian Fuel Company has shown no sign of slowing down! The results are in and thanks to me, Sindrian-brand Antimatter Fuel continues to be the most popular brand in the Persean Sector! I thank you all for your continued support, and may we continue to prove to all that Sindrian Antimatter Fuel is the best for this cycle and every cycle beyond! So remember, buy Sindrian! Or Else!" - The Magnanimous, Excellent, Glorious and Auspicious Supreme Chief Overlord President Executive Gas Station Manager Phillip Andrada's State of the Company Address circa c206.01.01.

Art by the Wonderful Luzaitis

Not Shpiner for creating a wonderful Sindrian Fuel Advertisement!

PLEASE START A NEW SAVE TO SEE ALL THE NEW FEATURES OF EACH MAJOR UPDATE.

Download v1.14.1a (INCOMPATIBLE WITH V0.97 STARSECTOR and V1.14.1 AND BELOW OF PAGSM)

Let Phillip Andrada live out his true dream: Being the best damned

Dictator

Gas Station Manager on this side of the Persean Sector.

Complete with more lively market music to all his customers coming to the various Sindrian Fuel Company™ gas stations in the Askonia star system.

Preview the fleet and weapons that will ensure that no outlaws or jealous rivals will stop you with the might of the Sindrian Fuel Fleet!

Please do not redistribute derivative works without permission.

PreviewsSpoiler

[close]

Looking to take your support for the Sindrian Diktat Fuel Company to the next level? Why not get Diktat Enhancement to go along with your Lobsters and Fuel?

Compatibility Warning:

Mods that affect the Sindrian Diktat .faction file may cause crashes.

v1.14.1a is not save game compatible. Please start a new save to experience the entirety of the mod to its fullest.

PAGSM has some amount of crossmod interaction with these mods. Thanks to the original mod makers, check out these mods!

SpoilerPAGSM Crossmod List:

Crossmod with added mechanics:

Diktat Enhancement

(Integration with new planets and changes. Please use latest version.)

Nexerelin

(Planet change description / HVP trade in rep reward / Unique Alliance Names/ Modified faction relationships)

Substance Abuse

(Gift drinks to NPCs)

Combat Chatter

(Unique Combat Chatter personalities for unique officers)

Commissioned Crews

(Adds campaign layer cc bonus, does not override Lion's Guard training)

United Auroran Federation

(Gift UAF goods to NPCs/ Captured Planet Descriptions with Nexerelin/ Unique Alliance Name)

Secrets of the Frontier

(Unique Sierra Interactions/ Custom Askonia miniquest)

Interstellar Imperium

(Gift Byzantine Wine/ Unique Alliance Name)

Oculian Armada

(Gift Oculian Cookies)

Special Hullmod Upgrades

(Special Hullmods for PAGSM colony items. Please get latest version.)

Custom Battle Music

(Adds a combat track for when fighting SFC fleets)

Arma Amatura

(Adds strikecraft variants of mechs in PAGSM)

Take No Prisoner

(Special Prisoner Interactions with specific unique officers)

Crossmod with description changes:

Iron Shell

(Unique Alliance Name/ Captured Planet Description)

Shadowyards Reconstruction Authority

(Unique Alliance Name/ Captured Planet Descriptions)

Star Federation

(Unique Alliance Name/ Captured Planet Descriptions)

Volkov Industrial Conglomorate

(Unique Alliance Name/ Captured Planet Descriptions)

Machina Void Shipyards

(Captured Planet Descriptions)

Mayasuran Navy

(Unique Alliance Name)

Other Mod Recommendations

Lobster Proliferation

- Makes Lobsters a demanded commodity! Perfect to ensure the continued dominance of Volturnian Lobsters!

Also check out

Interesting Portrait Packs for their cool portraits.

Change Log

Spoilerv1.14.1aa fix changelog

- Fixed Horacio Caden softlocking the game with his sheer presence

v1.14.1a hotfix changelog

- Updated to 0.98a release, PersonalFleet crash fixed

- Updated sprites for PM-15000 and missile weapons, thanks to Quacken

- Updated Museum gift items, thanks to Quacken

- Portrait art updates from Sumoga

- Now utilizes vanilla Lion's Guard flag and crest as needed

v1.14.1 changelog

- Fixed errors with Usurpers options not working

v1.14 changelog

- More text updates to change Sindrian Diktat mentions and similar information to Sindrian Fuel Company

- Added Porpax PX-50 frigate to fleet lineup

- Updated ship sprites of Dram DM-150 and Phaeton PN-1500

- Removed Monofilament Tow Cable from Lelantus LT-150

- The Lion's Guard will field the Murmidon Heavy Assault Mech and Murmex Assault Mech if ArmaA is active

- Modified the Ajax Fuel Tender sprite and weapons

- Adds the Ajax Heavy Fuel Tender strikecraft if ArmaA is active

- Removed the ammo mechanic for the Antimatter Thrower (Mech) weapon

- Updated ship loadouts to account for OP shifts in weapons

- Added alternative way to recruit Ruka Yenni if Take No Prisoner is not installed

- Reduced Hyder's level to 12, down from 15

- Reduced Caden's level to 6, down from 15

v1.14.preview build

- Hotfix compatible with 0.97a update.

- Changes are odd, strange and probably not fully in place.

- Short playtesting shows it at least works.

- Probably won't be too great.

- Oh, adds mechs too.

v1.13.1b hotfix

- Should fix issue with Diktat Enhancement Lite Mode settings fully now if also using LunaLib

- Added new content based on CombatChatter banter update

- Added officer led variants of certain ships for ship test mission

v1.13.1a hotfix

- Attempt to fix PersonalFleet crash for Horacio Caden, and similar fleets

v1.13.1 changelog

- Fixed bugs not sure if it really is fully fixed please scream at me if there is any more issues

- Fixed issue of certain built in hullmods not being s-moddable

- Added Aetos AS-1500 Tanker Cruiser

v1.13a hotfix

- Fixed random sector crash

v1.13 changelog

Additions

- Crossmod content with Random Assortment of Things and Tahlan Shipworks AI cores

- Added update checker with Lunalib

- Velmarie will now accept Hyperspace Data and Random Assortment of Things Abyss Data

- Added Pather version of the Lelantus LS-150

- Created custom versions of Caden and Hyder's fleets

Fixes

- Fixed Macario giving the player an extra Executor/ Cash if they already picked the option at the end of Usurpers

- Fixed Velmarie accepting non-survey data items if they were tagged as survey data

- Fixed Turret Accelerators S-Mod not reducing recoil

Changes

- Yunris Kween and Gregory Mannfred no longer appear on the Sindria commlink. They need to be met first elsewhere before you can contact them

- Code changes under the hood

- Renam

aiDescription: Adds a full faction, the Sindrian Fuel Company, with unique ships, weapons, officers, and fleet mechanics. Includes a new main menu mission, custom market music, and extensive crossmod support with other popular mods. Features a rich narrative with unique dialogue, recruitment chains, and faction interactions.
